snippet.title: CONTROL Resonant – Announcement Trailer | The Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat. 

CONTROL Resonant arrives in 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, and Mac via Steam and the App Store. Wishlist now. 

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017682/  
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p092299fsgw 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870/CONTROL_Resonant/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/control-resonant-3568d3 

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.   

Find out more at https://controlgame.com/

Twitter: https://x.com/ControlRemedy
